propositions: configure_logging() sets propagate=False on the 'rebar' logger globally, preventing subsequent caplog fixtures from capturing rebar.* log records in the same process.
A caplog-based test assertion on a rebar.* logger silently fails (StopIteration or vacuous pass) after configure_logging() has run in an earlier test within the same worker process.
The failure is intermittent and order-dependent: the same test suite passes or fails depending on test execution order across workers, making it undetectable in isolation.

The propagate=False mutation was intended to prevent double-logging through uvicorn/root, but uvicorn does not configure a root handler so propagation is safe and removal does not introduce duplication.
An autouse fixture or removal of the propagate mutation is required to restore caplog isolation for all rebar.* loggers while maintaining the no-double-logging invariant.
